subject.title: fix(agent): recover gateway runs before failing

question: Should `openclaw agent` replace the current immediate failure after an ambiguously accepted Gateway disconnect with a wait-and-cache-replay recovery path, including its altered latency and mixed-version behavior?
rationale: The existing merged behavior intentionally fails rather than duplicates an ambiguous turn, while the linked open issue identifies reattach-first as a user-visible trade-off rather than an established bug fix.

options.title: Approve reattach-first recovery
options.body: Accept the new recovery contract, require real fault-proxy proof and explicit mixed-version behavior, then review the protocol changes as the supported path.

options.title: Keep immediate failure
options.body: Retain the current fail-with-verification-hint contract and close this branch as an unapproved alternative direction.

options.title: Limit recovery by mode
options.body: Define a narrower policy such as recovery only for explicitly selected delivery-oriented workflows before accepting a protocol change.

recommendation.title: Approve reattach-first recovery
recommendation.body: Accept the new recovery contract, require real fault-proxy proof and explicit mixed-version behavior, then review the protocol changes as the supported path.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current fail-with-guidance contract and are best positioned to confirm whether this user-visible behavior should change.
